## LINK_CONFIG (port 0x04)

Link configuration state, sent continuously (about 2 Hz) by the Router (node 2, the configuration master) to the ship radio node (node 3). Never a one-shot event: the receiver applies the latest value and falls back to its defaults if the packet stops arriving for 10 s. Travels Router to air only; the Router drops it from USB, and unauthenticated on air (known issue). The ground station and the flight computer ignore it.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `tx_power_dbm` | i8 | dBm | requested RF output power of the ship radio node; the receiver clamps it to 0..board maximum |
| 1 | `flags` | u8 |  | reserved, send 0, ignore on receive |

## RC_STATE (port 0x10)

Sticks, switches and source validity of a handset (Radiomaster Pocket), sent continuously (25-50 Hz). GS-control design (2026-11-23): the vehicle no longer interprets RC_STATE; the Router sends it to the ground station only, and all vehicle commands travel in CMD_STATE (0x13). Layout unchanged.

Constants: `CH_MIN` = -1000, `CH_MAX` = 1000, `CH_INVALID` = -32768

| 1 | `reserved` | u8 |  |  |

## REQUEST (port 0x11)

One-shot non-safety action with an idempotent id. The action enum is in starship.toml (RequestAction). Exception: action LINK_UPLOAD_MODE (target = link module node id, 2 = TX, 3 = RX) makes that module stop the air link and enter its over-the-air firmware upload (WiFi) mode. It is always honoured with no safety condition (the module cannot know if the vehicle is flying), so senders must never send it unintentionally; arg_i and arg_f are 0, REQUEST_ACK detail is 0. Action LINK_REBOOT (11) has the same semantics (same target, always honoured, ACK first, same delay) but makes the module do a clean software restart instead; a reboot of the RX module in flight stops RC for a few seconds (failsafe), so senders must guard it. Vehicle actions (target 1, latched session required): 7 CALIB_APPLY (arg_i subsystem), 8 SAVE_CONFIG, 12 ZERO_ESTIMATORS, 13 SET_STOP_ALTITUDE, 14 CALIB_CONTROL (arg_i = subsystem*10 + code 1 start/2 verify/0 stop and fit/9 discard), 15..22 SIM_* (simulation mode only, else REJECTED_STATE 2/5), 23 GET_HOME_POSITION (DONE, then HOME_POSITION 0x50; REJECTED_STATE 2/4 if no home). Full table, ranges and detail codes: comment above RequestAction in starship.toml and versioning.md changelog.

| Offset | Field | Type | Unit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `req_id` | u16 |  | non-zero, new per action, reused on retry |
| 2 | `action` | u8 |  |  |
| 3 | `target` | u8 |  |  |
| 4 | `arg_i` | i32 |  |  |
| 8 | `arg_f` | f32 |  |  |
| 12 | `session` | u32 |  | CMD_STATE session id of the sender (gs-control design Q5). The vehicle accepts a vehicle-directed REQUEST (target = 1) only if session equals its latched CMD_STATE session (non-zero); 0 = none, so a missing field (older sender, 12-byte payload) decodes as 0 and is refused by the vehicle. Router/ship-node requests (LINK_UPLOAD_MODE, LINK_REBOOT, target 2 or 3) ignore the field. Optional (append-only), default 0. |

## CMD_STATE (port 0x13)

GS-control design (2026-11-23): the complete command state of the ground station (node 0) to the vehicle (node 1), level-based and repeated at 25 Hz (plus an immediate frame on every change), identical frame (same sequence) on every link. Strict: every field must be a declared value (enum members, version 1, session non-zero, reserved zero, flags bit 0 set and only bits 0..2); anything else rejects the whole frame, which counts as no data (decode fails). No authentication field (owner decision 2026-11-23). Port 0x13 is in the common control range so routers class it as CONTROL without knowing this layout; only src 0 -> dst 1 is forwarded. The SA..SE mapping: go = SA, profile = SB, vehicle_mode = SC (command value 0 = real, 1 and 2 = simulation on the handset; the vehicle boots real), motors = SD (motors armed / disarmed), reset_button = SE (short press reset, hold >= 1 s zero while held), go = mission begin edge request (NOT_GO -> GO observed edge).

| Offset | Field | Type | Unit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `flags` | u8 |  | VALID must be 1. POCKET_LIVE (the handset stream is alive at the GS) and INPUT_VIRTUAL (input is the virtual panel) are information only: the vehicle reports them, never acts on them. Bits 3..7 must be 0. Bits: VALID = bit 0, POCKET_LIVE = bit 1, INPUT_VIRTUAL = bit 2. Allowed: 1, 3, 5, 7; any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 1 | `version` | u8 |  | CMD_STATE layout version, must be 1 Allowed: 1; any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 2 | `session` | u32 |  | random per GS process start, never 0; the vehicle latches one session and rejects frames of any other Allowed: (min 1); any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 6 | `go` | enum CmdGo |  | SA: mission begin edge request. NOT_GO also aborts while pending or running Allowed: 0, 1; any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 7 | `profile` | u8 |  | SB position 0, 1, 2, latched at the go edge Allowed: 0, 1, 2; any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 8 | `vehicle_mode` | enum CmdVehicleMode |  | SC: REAL = command value 0, SIMULATION = 1 and 2 (the vehicle boots real); an observed change is applied on the ground when not committed Allowed: 0, 1; any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 9 | `motors` | enum CmdMotors |  | SD: motors armed (ENABLED) / disarmed (DISABLED), the interlock input Allowed: 0, 1; any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 10 | `reset_button` | enum CmdButton |  | SE: short press = reset, hold >= 1 s = zero while held Allowed: 0, 1; any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 11 | `failsafe` | enum CmdFailsafe |  | FAILSAFE = GS failsafe requested (latched failsafe on the vehicle, any state); sent together with motors DISABLED and go NOT_GO Allowed: 0, 1; any other value rejects the whole frame. |
| 12 | `reserved` | u16 |  | must be 0 (kept so the payload stays 14 B) Allowed: 0; any other value rejects the whole frame. |

Mode and health, the slow class. Reports what the vehicle applied (safety.md 2.6).

| 13 | `mission_mode` | u8 |  |  |
| 14 | `mission_phase` | u8 |  |  |
| 15 | `ctrl_source` | enum ControlSource |  | active control source: 0 none, 1 GS (the latched CMD_STATE session) |
| 16 | `flags` | u8 |  | ARMED (redefined by T9b, 2026-11-22): motors armed = the motor interlock is open (CMD_STATE motors ENABLED accepted; SD is named motors armed / disarmed); the vehicle-side arm state is no longer a separate flag. MOTORS_ENABLED: the interlock is open AND the motor outputs are enabled (the hard motor gate is open). UART_PEER_SEEN: a valid frame from the ship radio node (node 3) arrived on the vehicle UART within the last 3 s (information only, the vehicle never acts on it). ZEROING: an estimator zeroing window is active (automatic boot zero or ZeroEstimators); the vehicle must be kept still, Arm and MissionBegin are refused. Bits: ARMED = bit 0, SIMULATION = bit 1, MOTORS_ENABLED = bit 2, GS_PRESENT = bit 3, INCOMPATIBLE = bit 4, FAILSAFE = bit 5, UART_PEER_SEEN = bit 6, ZEROING = bit 7. |
| 17 | `failure_bits` | u32 |  | bit 0 sensor (set for any sensor failsafe, kept for compatibility), 1 attitude, 2 position, 3 position out of bounds, 4 attitude out of bounds, 5 CONTROL_SOURCE_LOST (renamed from radio connection loss: the accepted CMD_STATE was older than 2 s while committed), 6 GNSS lost (abort to no-position RTH), 7 magnetometer lost (abort to no-position RTH), 8 barometer, 9 gyro, 10 accelerometer, 11 attitude estimate, 12 position estimate, 13 motor-interlock watchdog. Bits 6-13 are defined by T9b; a sender before T9b never sets them. 14 GS_FAILSAFE (an accepted CMD_STATE carried failsafe = 1; latched, cleared by the SE reset while the request is 0). Bits 15..31 are reserved (zero). |
| 21 | `sensor_state` | u16 |  |  |
| 23 | `last_req_id` | u16 |  | last executed REQUEST id, 0 = none |
| 25 | `last_req_status` | u8 |  | RequestStatus value of last_req_id |
| 26 | `rc_age` | fixed u16 (scale 0.001, invalid 65535) | s | age of the last accepted CMD_STATE (either link), invalid (NaN) = none |
| 28 | `home_epoch` | u8 |  | increments whenever the home reference (HOME_POSITION) changes; the GS requests HOME_POSITION again when it changes. 0 = no home yet. Missing (older sender) decodes as 0 Optional (append-only), default 0. |
| 29 | `calib_state` | u8 |  | calibration state bits. bit0 gyro calibration valid, bit1 accel calibration valid, bit2 mag calibration valid, bit3 a calibration session is active (collecting or fitting), bit4 ready to arm (all gates the vehicle applies for Arm and MissionBegin are satisfied), bits 5-7 reserved (zero). Missing (older sender) decodes as 0 = unknown Optional (append-only), default 0. |
| 30 | `ctrl_flags` | u16 |  | T9b command-path state. INTERLOCK_NEED_TOGGLE: SD must be toggled disabled -> enabled before the interlock opens. ABORT_LATCHED / FAILSAFE_LATCHED: latched until the SE reset (CMD_STATE reset_button) while disarmed on the ground. NOPOS_RTH: the no-position return-to-home is active. SC_MISMATCH: SC differs from the applied mode. SE_HOLD_ZEROING: SE held, zeroing in progress. SE_REFUSED: an SE press was refused (shown for 2 s). USB_FRESH / UART_FRESH (bits 7 and 8, formerly RADIO_FRESH / BENCH_FRESH): an accepted or duplicate CMD_STATE of the latched session arrived on that link at most 2 s ago (information only). SOURCE_LATCHED: the GS session is latched because the vehicle is committed. REQ_QUEUE_FULL: the REQUEST queue is full. MULTI_MASTER: a CMD_STATE of a foreign session was rejected within the last 2 s. GS_FAILSAFE_REQ: the last accepted CMD_STATE carried failsafe = 1. Bits 13..15 reserved (zero). Missing (older sender) decodes as 0 Bits: INTERLOCK_NEED_TOGGLE = bit 0, ABORT_LATCHED = bit 1, FAILSAFE_LATCHED = bit 2, NOPOS_RTH = bit 3, SC_MISMATCH = bit 4, SE_HOLD_ZEROING = bit 5, SE_REFUSED = bit 6, USB_FRESH = bit 7, UART_FRESH = bit 8, SOURCE_LATCHED = bit 9, REQ_QUEUE_FULL = bit 10, MULTI_MASTER = bit 11, GS_FAILSAFE_REQ = bit 12. Optional (append-only), default 0. |

Bits 3..7 reserved (zero). Missing decodes as 0 Bits: TOF_LOST = bit 0, LINK_STATS_LOST = bit 1, UART_HEARTBEAT_LOST = bit 2. Optional (append-only), default 0. |

## AIR_ACTUATORS (port 0x22)

Actuator outputs for flight recording over the radio: two samples per packet (newest and the previous one, nominally 20 ms older), so 25 packets/s give 50 samples/s and one lost packet loses no sample. Same source and definitions as ACTUATORS. Array order: the newest sample first, then the previous one.

| 6 | `tvc` | fixed i16 (scale 0.0001, invalid -32768) x 4 | rad | thrust vector deflection as ACTUATORS.tvc: [x, y] newest, then [x, y] previous; +-3.2767 rad at 0.1 mrad |

## AIR_GNSS (port 0x24)

GNSS position and velocity for the radio at 10 Hz, the air version of GNSS (same source values), fixed-point. Purpose: verify the barometric/estimated altitude during descent. Fix type, satellites and accuracy are in AIR_GNSS_INFO at 1 Hz. The u-blox driver provides the NED velocity vector, so the full velocity is sent, converted to NWU as in GNSS.vel.

| Offset | Field | Type | Unit | Notes |

## CMD_APPLIED (port 0x84)

GS-control design, USB only (no air cost; replaces RC_APPLIED at 0x84): the CMD_STATE fields as the vehicle applies them (last accepted frame of the latched session), the transition detectors' safe-seen bits, ages, the latched session and the reject counters. For bench debugging of the command path.

| Offset | Field | Type | Unit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `t_us` | u32 | us |  |
| 4 | `go` | enum CmdGo |  | last accepted go (NOT_GO if none yet) |
| 5 | `profile` | u8 |  | last accepted profile 0, 1, 2 |
| 6 | `vehicle_mode` | enum CmdVehicleMode |  | last accepted vehicle_mode field (not the applied mode) |
| 7 | `motors` | enum CmdMotors |  | last accepted motors field |
| 8 | `reset_button` | enum CmdButton |  | last accepted reset_button field |
| 9 | `failsafe` | enum CmdFailsafe |  | last accepted failsafe field |
| 10 | `flags` | u8 |  | the information flags of the last accepted CMD_STATE (POCKET_LIVE = CMD_STATE flags bit 1, INPUT_VIRTUAL = bit 2); reported, never acted on. Bits 2..7 reserved Bits: POCKET_LIVE = bit 0, INPUT_VIRTUAL = bit 1. |
| 11 | `safe_seen` | u8 |  | each unsafe-direction detector's 'safe value seen' bit (set: an edge may be reported). SC_REAL: vehicle_mode REAL seen (or SIMULATION seen for the reverse edge, as the mapper defines it). Bits 4..7 reserved Bits: GO = bit 0, SC_REAL = bit 1, SD_ENABLE = bit 2, SE_PRESS = bit 3. |
| 12 | `session` | u32 |  | full latched session id, 0 = none |
| 16 | `age` | fixed u16 (scale 0.001, invalid 65535) | s | age of the last accepted CMD_STATE (either link), invalid (NaN) = none |
| 18 | `usb_age` | fixed u16 (scale 0.001, invalid 65535) | s | age of the last accepted or duplicate copy of the latched session on the USB link, invalid (NaN) = none |
| 20 | `uart_age` | fixed u16 (scale 0.001, invalid 65535) | s | same for the UART link |
| 22 | `rejects` | u8 x 4 |  | wrapping reject counters per reason: [0] bad length or field out of range, [1] source (src not 0), [2] foreign session, [3] stale or duplicate sequence |

## GNSS (port 0x83)

GNSS solution at 10 Hz (the latest receiver solution; 5 Hz before 2026-11-21). Latitude and longitude in radians as f64 (full receiver resolution, 1e-7 degree is about 1 cm), altitude in metres as the receiver driver reports it (the u-blox height above the WGS-84 ellipsoid, not above mean sea level: it differs from the barometric altitude by the geoid separation, so compare changes or values relative to the pad, not absolute values). Used to verify the barometric/estimated altitude during descent; AIR_GNSS is the compact version for the radio.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `t_us` | u32 | us |  |

| 20 | `altitude` | f32 | m |  |
| 24 | `vel` | f32 x 3 | m/s | NWU |
| 36 | `satellites` | u8 |  |  |

| 38 | `h_acc` | f32 | m |  |
| 42 | `v_acc` | f32 | m |  |
| 46 | `s_acc` | f32 | m/s |  |

## CALIBRATION (port 0x93)

Sensor calibration currently applied by the vehicle (continuous state, USB only, sent at 0.5 Hz: every 2 s; the integer rate fields cannot express it). Reproduces the calibrated gyro, accel and mag values from IMU_RAW: for each sensor, cal = M * (raw - offset) with M the 3x3 *_matrix row-major (M[r][c] = matrix[3*r + c]) and raw the IMU_RAW field in raw_frame; no temperature terms, no further remap. M already includes the sensor->body transform, so cal is in the body frame. The *_source bits say where the values came from. gyro_bias_est is the attitude EKF's own gyro bias state, subtracted after calibration (POSE omega = gyro cal - gyro_bias_est).

| Offset | Field | Type | Unit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `t_us` | u32 | us |  |
| 4 | `raw_frame` | enum ImuFrame |  | frame of the IMU_RAW values these parameters apply to (SENSOR = driver output frame, before calibration) |
| 5 | `gyro_source` | u8 |  | CALIB_EEPROM: offset/scale item read from EEPROM (else identity defaults). TRANSFORM_EEPROM: sensor->body matrix read from EEPROM (else identity). OFFSET_OVERRIDE: offset hard-coded in the firmware, the stored one is ignored. RAM_ONLY: changed at run time, not saved yet. MEMORY_CLEARED: EEPROM image cleared at boot (version mismatch) Bits: CALIB_EEPROM = bit 0, TRANSFORM_EEPROM = bit 1, OFFSET_OVERRIDE = bit 2, RAM_ONLY = bit 3, MEMORY_CLEARED = bit 4. |
| 6 | `accel_source` | u8 |  | as gyro_source Bits: CALIB_EEPROM = bit 0, TRANSFORM_EEPROM = bit 1, OFFSET_OVERRIDE = bit 2, RAM_ONLY = bit 3, MEMORY_CLEARED = bit 4. |
| 7 | `mag_source` | u8 |  | as gyro_source Bits: CALIB_EEPROM = bit 0, TRANSFORM_EEPROM = bit 1, OFFSET_OVERRIDE = bit 2, RAM_ONLY = bit 3, MEMORY_CLEARED = bit 4. |
| 8 | `gyro_offset` | f32 x 3 | rad/s | subtracted from the raw gyro, raw frame |
| 20 | `gyro_matrix` | f32 x 9 |  | row-major 3x3, scale/misalignment times sensor->body |
| 56 | `accel_offset` | f32 x 3 | m/s^2 | subtracted from the raw accel, raw frame |
| 68 | `accel_matrix` | f32 x 9 |  | row-major 3x3, scale/misalignment times sensor->body |
| 104 | `mag_offset` | f32 x 3 | T | hard-iron offset, subtracted from the raw mag, raw frame |
| 116 | `mag_matrix` | f32 x 9 |  | row-major 3x3, soft-iron/scale times sensor->body (dimensionless: T in, T out) |
| 152 | `gyro_bias_est` | f32 x 3 | rad/s | attitude EKF gyro bias state, body frame, subtracted from the calibrated gyro |

## MISSION_PARAMS (port 0x26)

Mission parameters the vehicle currently uses (readback of REQUEST action SET_MISSION_PARAM 24; the stop altitude is in MISSION.stop_altitude and not repeated). Plain state packet, vehicle to ground station: USB at 1 Hz, radio at 0.5 Hz (every 2 s; the integer rate_air cannot express it, so it is not set and the air budget test does not count it: 31 B frame * 0.5 = 15.5 B/s, air set 2979 -> about 2994.5 B/s, still < 3000). NaN = unknown. Defaults at boot (not stored): ascent_speed 7 m/s, apogee_altitude 120 m, hover_hold_s 30 s, p1_hold_1_s 10 s, p1_hold_2_s 15 s, p1_hold_3_s 15 s.

| Offset | Field | Type | Unit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `ascent_speed` | f32 | m/s | climb speed to the apogee waypoint (flight profile) |
| 4 | `apogee_altitude` | f32 | m | apogee waypoint altitude above the position reference |
| 8 | `hover_hold_s` | f32 | s | profile 0 hover test hold time |
| 12 | `p1_hold_1_s` | f32 | s | profile 1 first hold (1 m) |
| 16 | `p1_hold_2_s` | f32 | s | profile 1 hold at 2 m x |
| 20 | `p1_hold_3_s` | f32 | s | profile 1 hold at 2 m x and 2 m y |

## HOME_POSITION (port 0x50)

Response object of the request channel 0x50 (workspace docs/reliable-transport-design.md 8.1; the generator does not yet know `kind = request`, so this is a plain packet definition of the object, and the transport sends it through RequestChannel/ResponderChannel, not as a stream). The REQUEST ARGS are EMPTY (zero bytes): the GS asks, the vehicle answers once; it is not streamed. Home = the position estimator's reference (the NWU origin), set at reset, refined in zeroing windows, fixed from go to landing unless reset. Failure (no reference yet) is the response status NO_DATA of the transport, not a field here.

| Offset | Field | Type | Unit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `flags` | u8 |  | LATLON_VALID: latitude/longitude are set. ALT_VALID: altitude is set. SIMULATION: the reference comes from the simulator, not from GNSS. ZEROING: an estimator zeroing window was active (the reference may still be refined) Bits: LATLON_VALID = bit 0, ALT_VALID = bit 1, SIMULATION = bit 2, ZEROING = bit 3. |
| 1 | `latitude` | fixed i32 (scale 1.7453292519943295e-09, invalid -2147483648) | rad | wire: deg * 1e7; NaN when LATLON_VALID is clear |
| 5 | `longitude` | fixed i32 (scale 1.7453292519943295e-09, invalid -2147483648) | rad | wire: deg * 1e7; NaN when LATLON_VALID is clear |
| 9 | `altitude` | fixed i32 (scale 0.001, invalid -2147483648) | m | the origin's altitude as the estimator uses it (same datum as GNSS.altitude), 1 mm; NaN when ALT_VALID is clear |
| 13 | `h_acc` | fixed u16 (scale 0.01, invalid 65535) | m | horizontal accuracy of the reference, 1 cm steps, 65535 = unknown (NaN) |
| 15 | `epoch` | u8 |  | increments whenever the home reference changes (the value VEHICLE_STATUS.home_epoch will carry); lets the GS detect a stale copy |
| 16 | `set_time` | i64 | ns | vehicle time (ns) when the reference was last set or refined; 0 = never |
| 24 | `reserved` | u8 |  | zero |
